# Sagar Sync

> Sagar Sync is a comprehensive, all-in-one service platform based in Makroniya, Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, India. It serves as a single point of contact for individuals, coaching centres, shop owners, businesses, and builders for digital, creative, printing, media, legal, events, and construction services.

## Core Philosophy

"Understand first, quote later." Every quote is custom-tailored to the client's scope. No rigid upfront price lists. The process is:
1. Inquiry logged (via form, WhatsApp, or direct outreach)
2. Discovery conversation to understand project scope
3. Rough layout, wireframe, or concept provided at NO CHARGE
4. Detailed itemised quote presented
5. Client approves and work begins with clear milestones

## Service Catalogue (10 Categories)

### 1. Design & Branding
- Logo Design — Custom logos for businesses, coaching centres, shops, professionals, NGOs, and events
- Brand Identity — Complete brand systems: colour palette, typography, brand guidelines, stationery
- Banner Design — Flex banners, digital banners, hoardings, social media banners
- Business Cards — Visiting card design and printing: standard, premium, folded formats
- Invitations — Wedding cards, event invitations, birthday cards: design and printing
- Booklet / Handbook — Company profiles, product catalogues, coaching handbooks, annual reports
- Art & Craft Work — Custom handmade art, craft products, decorative items, gift crafting

### 2. Websites & Digital Presence
- Business Website — Professional multi-page websites for any type of business
- Landing Pages — Single-page conversion-focused websites for campaigns or products
- E-Commerce Website — Full online store with product listings, cart, and payment gateway
- Online Ordering System — Website or app feature for restaurants, shops, and local retailers
- Online Presence Setup — Google Business listing, social media profiles, local SEO setup
- Website Maintenance — Ongoing updates, security, hosting management, and support

### 3. Software & App Development
- Billing Software — Custom billing/invoicing software with bill printing and payment records
- Stock Management — Inventory tracking with low-stock alerts, supplier records, and reorder triggers
- Daily Sales & Profit Tracker — Auto-calculates daily revenue, cost, profit; generates monthly summaries
- Easy Return System — Streamlined product return and exchange tracking within billing software
- QR & Cash Payment Support — Software supports both cash and QR/UPI payments at checkout
- Mobile Application — Android/iOS apps for businesses, coaching centres, or service platforms
- Custom Software — Any bespoke business software: attendance, payroll, reporting, etc.

### 4. Coaching Institute Solutions
- Online Presence — Website, Google listing, social media setup for the coaching centre
- Notes & Study Material Design — Professional design of coaching notes, worksheets, and practice papers
- Notebook & Book Design — Custom-branded notebooks, exercise books, and student handbooks
- Fee Management Software — Digital fee collection, payment tracking, receipt generation
- Auto Fee Notifications — Automated WhatsApp/SMS reminders sent to students every month to pay fees
- Student Result Management — System to record, manage, and share exam results with students/parents
- Student Portal / App — Dedicated portal for students to access notes, results, and announcements
- Logo & Branding — Full brand identity for the coaching institute

### 5. Shop & Retail Owner Solutions
- Shop Website — Professional website showcasing products and services
- Online Order Feature — Add online ordering to their website or via WhatsApp automation
- Billing Software — POS-style billing with bill printing and payment support
- Stock Alert System — Real-time stock monitoring, alerts when items fall below threshold
- Daily Profit Calculator — Calculates daily sales, cost, and profit automatically
- Monthly Sales Report — Auto-generated monthly profit and loss summaries
- Bill Printing — Thermal printer integration for paper receipts
- QR / Cash Payments — Accept UPI/QR and cash payments, tracked in software
- Easy Returns — Built-in return and exchange management in the billing system

### 6. Printing Services
- Visiting Cards — Single-sided, double-sided, and premium card printing
- Flex & Banners — Large format flex printing for shops, events, and campaigns
- Brochures & Flyers — A4/A5/tri-fold brochures for marketing
- Stationery — Letterheads, envelopes, notepads, stamps
- Coaching Notebooks — Branded notebooks with custom covers for coaching centres
- Booklets & Handbooks — Saddle-stitched or perfect-bound printed booklets

### 7. Photography & Videography
- Wedding Photography — Full wedding day coverage: mehendi, haldi, ceremony, reception
- Wedding Videography — Cinematic wedding films, highlight reels, drone coverage
- Pre-wedding Shoot — Location-based pre-wedding photo and video sessions
- Product Photography — Studio and lifestyle shots for online stores and catalogues
- Event Photography — Corporate events, birthday parties, school functions, openings
- Video Editing — Post-production editing for any video: colour grade, music, graphics
- Reels & Short Videos — Social media-ready short videos for Instagram, YouTube Shorts

### 8. Legal & Financial Services
- Lawyer Consultation — Connect with local qualified lawyers for legal advice and documentation
- Income Tax Filing — ITR filing for individuals and businesses
- GST Registration & Returns — GST registration, monthly and quarterly return filing
- CA Services — Chartered accountant work: audits, balance sheets, tax planning
- Business Registration — Company or firm registration, MSME registration, trade licence
- Legal Documentation — Agreements, affidavits, NOCs, rental deeds, and other legal papers

### 9. Events & Function Management
- Wedding Planning — End-to-end wedding coordination: venue, decor, catering, schedule
- Tent & Shamiana — Tent and canopy setup for weddings, jagrans, and outdoor events
- Catering Coordination — Catering tie-up and management for functions of all sizes
- Stage & Decoration — Stage setup, floral decoration, lighting, entrance arches
- Birthday & Parties — Kids' parties, adult birthdays, milestone celebrations
- Corporate Events — Office launches, seminars, award functions, brand events
- Programme Management — Any kind of function or programme: cultural, religious, social

### 10. Construction & Trade Services
- House Mapping — Architectural floor plans and building layouts for residential properties
- CAD Drawings — Computer-aided design drawings for construction and renovation projects
- Carpentry Work — Custom furniture, cabinets, wooden fixtures, and interior carpentry
- Iron Smithing — Fabrication of iron structures, grilles, gates, and custom metalwork
- Iron Welding — Structural welding and repair work for residential and commercial needs
- General Construction — Renovation, extension, interior construction, and flooring work
- Interior Consulting — Basic space planning and interior layout advice

- Hyperlocal Expertise: Physically based in Sagar, allowing site visits and local shoots
